All about our European moves
How long does the journey take?

Loading and delivery dates are set after reviewing your volume and access. With a shared load, dates are more flexible.

Can I store some belongings in France?

Yes, CODEM storage can keep what is not leaving straight away.

What should I prepare?

A detailed inventory, the declaration of value and precise access details at destination (floor, lift, parking). Your adviser guides you.
